question: Should ClawHub now support declared MIT licenses for skill packages with root MIT metadata, reversing the earlier fixed MIT-0-only direction?
rationale: The patch is narrower than prior broad license-selector work, but it still changes the legal/product contract for published skills and production backfill behavior; automation cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Approve declared MIT support after copy/backfill fixes
options.body: Land the mixed MIT/MIT-0 model only after the stale MIT-0 consent subtitle is removed and maintainers have a clear production backfill/runbook path.

options.title: Future versions only
options.body: Keep the detection work for new publishes/imports but explicitly defer existing-version repair to a separately approved migration or maintenance run.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the March product direction still stands and ClawHub should not preserve upstream MIT metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve declared MIT support after copy/backfill fixes
recommendation.body: Land the mixed MIT/MIT-0 model only after the stale MIT-0 consent subtitle is removed and maintainers have a clear production backfill/runbook path.
